authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5005 challi lists Hindi chālā “skin, hide”, borrowed into neighboring Indo-Aryan languages, and Bihari chāl/challā. The survey chala forms fit this family; their precise intra-IA route remains open under the user’s linking preference. Joint comparison: Majhi cʰala “skin” matches reviewed Dang tʃʰala “skin” (f_c4apevy3rbhrk). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
